clues: This city sits in West Java. It lies just south of Jakarta, the main city of the land.
Rain showers fall here a lot, even in the dry time of year. That odd mix is why folks call it the Rainy City.
Long ago this place was the main city of the Sunda Kingdom. Its old name then was Pakuan Pajajaran.
Its town core is one of the most packed spots on Earth. A few hundred thousand folks live in one small patch.
This city is known for its grand palace and vast plant garden. The garden is one of the oldest and largest in the world.
